title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Cut the Chain

lines.l: On the whole parade
Silver chain swinging but your confidence looks staged
I caught you staring while I moved across the floor
But every step I take reminds you I'm not yours anymore
You try your stories, hoping I fall for the game
But every line you drop feels hollow is the same
I'm done pretending you're a fire I can't tame
Tonight I rise without a trace of your name
You keep calling like you think I turn around
But I found better places to be found
I'm not falling back again
I'm dancing free, I cut the chain
You thought you had me in your frame
But I'm slipping out, I'm not your claim
You used to whisper promises you couldn't keep
Sweet words floating, but they never ran too deep
I learned your rhythm, every trick behind your smile
A pretty mask that only lasted for a while
Now when you reach for me, I feel nothing at all
Your echo fades like flame, peeling off the wall
I'm stepping forward, standing tall
Your chapters close, I won't recall
You keep calling like you think I'll turn around
But I found better places to be found
I'm not falling back again
I'm dancing free, I cut the chain
You thought you had me in your frame
But I'm stepping out, I'm not your claim
No more stories, no more chase
I'm done with shadows in your space
I found my rhythm, found my pace
Your memories fade in without a trap
So keep your roses, keep your crown
I'm not the one, you get to drown
I'm rising up, I'm city bound
And nothing's pulling me back down
